mentions.name: Postware
mentions.description: Postware is an open alternative to legacy SaaS for AI-native companies. It provides free hosted open data models, MCP, and skills to replace SaaS services when used with agents.
mentions.problem: Using legacy SaaS with agents is expensive and the rate limits are too low.
mentions.source_excerpt:
We're building an open alternative for the next generation of AI-native companies.

https://postware.ai – Free hosted open data models, MCP and skills to replace SaaS

https://github.com/postware-ai/postware – Github
